 Jon Pardi Tour 2026 & 2027: Every Date, City & Venue
 October 28, 2026 
 Key Takeaways
 Jon Pardi’s 2026–2027 run centers on the Gamblin’ Man Tour headline dates, December support slots, and 2027 festival appearances.
 The Gamblin’ Man Tour 2026 spans September through November with 16 U.S. arena and amphitheater headline shows, including postponed dates.
 Several 2026 headline dates shifted into 2027, including Loveland, West Valley City, and Nampa, which now appear as Gamblin’ Man Tour 2027 stops.
 Confirmed 2027 appearances include Hondo Rodeo Fest in Tampa plus rescheduled Gamblin’ Man Tour headline dates in Idaho, Colorado, and Utah.
 OnesToWatch Live remains the central place to track Jon Pardi’s schedule and secure tickets for upcoming dates.
